structured.feedback: The description is about 230 words in Markdown with clear subheadings and a call to action. It leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes, and its claims mostly come from the product details. Minor flaws are the unsupported "keeps your dog comfortable" line, the slight overpromise in "rivals a professional visit", and benefits that are thin compared with the features.
